title: machine: timeout built-in SSH command checks
body:
Add a 30-second timeout to SSH command execution in localhostBuiltinSSH()
to prevent indefinite blocking when the remote SSH server hangs during
command execution. This addresses issue #29880 where OpenSSH 10.2p1
interoperability issues could cause podman machine start to hang forever.

The timeout applies to the entire command execution (session.Run()), not
just connection establishment. When the timeout expires, the SSH session
is closed to unblock the goroutine and a clear timeout error is returned.

The existing Starting state cleanup mechanism (defer in startLocked()) now
correctly resets Starting=false when SSH timeout occurs, preventing the
machine from being stuck in "Currently starting" state.

Fixes #29880

comments.body:
@l0rd PTAL , I investigated the CI failure for PR #29882.

The failure is from `podman logs - --since --follow journald` in `test/system/035-logs.bats`, which tests journald log behavior and does not exercise the SSH code changed by this PR (`pkg/machine/ssh.go`).

The test is timing-sensitive and has been associated with existing CI flakes around journald/log-follow behavior. The failure occurred independently of the new `localhostBuiltinSSH()` timeout logic.

I also verified:
- `go test ./pkg/machine -run TestSSHCommandTimeoutConstant -v` — PASS
- `git diff --check` — PASS
- No tracked working-tree changes related to the investigation.

I did not make any code changes. I recommend rerunning the failed CI job rather than modifying the PR for this unrelated test failure.
